description: Source code for a Go plugin that generates equality and verbose equality methods for protobuf message types, including handling of extensions, oneof fields, and various data types.

classes.name: plugin
classes.description: A plugin struct for generating equality methods for protobuf messages.

methods.name: NewPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the equality plugin.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin, 'equal'.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a generator instance.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates equality and verbose equality methods for each message in the file descriptor.

methods.name: generateNullableField
methods.description: Generates code to compare nullable fields, with verbose error messages if enabled.

methods.name: generateMsgNullAndTypeCheck

methods.name: generateField
